---
description: Deliver a coding task in CivicArch using shared instructions and task guidance.
---

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and [engineering standards](../../docs/engineering-standards.md), then read and follow the shared [Deliver a coding task template](../../docs/prompts/deliver-task.md). Use the current user request as task input; resolve template placeholders from it and repository evidence. Ask only about consequential missing intent. Do not treat unfilled placeholders as instructions to invent requirements.
